title: Raw SQL text in app modules must be a static literal, never dynamically built
intent: Dynamic ``text(...)`` / ``sqlalchemy.text(...)`` calls (f-strings, string concatenation, ``.format``, ``%`` formatting, or a variable) are not statically reviewable and are easy to turn into SQL injection. Keep SQL as a literal and pass data through SQLAlchemy parameters / ORM expressions instead. As a security rule this also scans ``tests/`` and ``migrations/`` dirs inside a module — they are importable Python, so they are application surface too.
